# Victor Svizev

> Senior Magento / Adobe Commerce developer with 9+ years of experience in commercial extension development, platform upgrades, and compatibility engineering, with a strong background in remote work. Independently designs, builds, and sells Magento 2 extensions on the Adobe Commerce Marketplace, with 100+ paid purchases to date. Experienced in modernizing legacy Magento systems and integrating them with modern technologies, including Hyvä and Adobe App Builder.

## Resume

- [CV / Resume](https://vsvizev.github.io/): Full resume, including experience, education, technical expertise, languages, and certifications.

## Experience

- Senior Magento / Adobe Commerce developer at TechDivision GmbH (remote, Feb 2023 – present): maintains and evolves a large ecosystem of Magento extensions with Symfony-based components used across dozens of production client projects; owns platform upgrades, Hyvä compatibility modules, and an Adobe App Builder application published on Adobe Exchange.
- Backend Magento / Adobe Commerce developer at netz98 GmbH (remote, Aug 2022 – Jan 2023): backend development across three Magento 2 B2B and B2C client projects.
- Full-Stack Magento / Adobe Commerce developer at UNlimited world trade union GmbH (remote since 2018, Feb 2017 – Jul 2022): frontend and backend development for in-house Magento B2B and B2C stores, including Magento 1 to Magento 2 migrations.
